purpose: The SHARED labelled cohort for PRD sec 6.3's per-view firm baselines. Published so 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp~Y measures view 2 on the SAME entities rather than re-deriving them: a second parse differing by ONE token would make 6.3 a comparison of two different cohorts while still returning two well-formed numbers. 1.0.0_SA_CTO~X POPULATION RULING 80564 item (2).
ruling: 1.0.0_SA_CTO~X 80564 (032059Z): the wave-2 firm label IS the parsed token, basis INFERRED; the unlabelled are OUTSIDE 6.3's denominator, recorded ABSENT, never zero.

parse_rule.semantics: an entity joins the cohort iff EXACTLY ONE distinct firm token matches; zero matches -> ABSENT (outside 6.3's denominator); more than one -> excluded and listed, so an ambiguous id is never silently assigned
parse_rule.basis: INFERRED -- no entity record in the ratified population carries a firm field (keys: entity_id, node_type, layer, features). A DECLARED per-entity firm is a NAMED GAP owed by the L1 spine (ruling 80564 item 3) and would lift this to MEASURED at a later run.
